stem: A moisture sensor near the container edge reads dry while hand checks near the active root mass remain moist. What is the best response?
choices: Irrigate from the edge reading because the driest measured location should determine the timing for the entire container
Move the sensor closer to the wall so repeated measurements come from the location that dries first after irrigation
Average the sensor value with room humidity to create a single moisture estimate for irrigation scheduling
Evaluate sensor placement and moisture variation before treating either location as representative of the root zone
rationale: Root-zone moisture can vary spatially. A sensor should represent the zone being managed, and conflicting locations should trigger evaluation of placement and distribution rather than an automatic irrigation response.
